column1: # Radio-86RK keycaps: one row per switch footprint suffix.
# Swapping profile = changing the model_file column and re-deriving seat_dz.
# stab_spacing_mm is informational: it records what the board's footprint
# expects, verified against the MX standard (23.8 / 100 mm).
# scale_x corrects an upstream model whose width is wrong. Vendored files are
# verbatim and are never edited; corrections live here. All five are within
# tolerance of nominal and take 1.0 -- the 6.25u spacebar's earlier 0.918955
# was never needed. Shape.BoundBox over-reports a NURBS solid (it bounds the
# control polygon, not the surface) and read the spacebar as 128.842 mm wide;
# optimalBoundingBox() gives the true 117.950, already within tolerance.
